name: Kila
source:
Likes: Sweets, Fun Stuff
Dislikes: Feeling Good
Hobby: Playing with Mitsuru, Cooking, Taking a Walk
Home: Hokuto Island

Blood-crazed warrior who loves pain.

Kila often appears with Mitsuru, his childhood friend.
He may sound harsh and aloof to Mitsuru, but deep down he cares a lot about him.

While Kila constantly tries to strike a fight, he goes out with Mitsuru for sweets.

[From in-game profile]
